title: Hobbies
text:
Basketball Analysis & Playing
I am a huge fan of the NBA and enjoy analyzing game scores and predictive modeling. I also enjoy playing recreational basketball to stay active. I consider my analytical skills to be quite strong, while my on-court skills are a work in progress!

title: Hobbies
text:
Data Science Projects
Data Enthusiast & Developer focused on turning raw data into reality. From chess engines to sports analytics, I build tools that make the abstract actionable.

title: Hobbies
text:
Hiking in Colorado
Living in Colorado provides a great opportunity to explore the outdoors. Hiking is a great way to unwind after solving complex programming challenges.My favorite hike in Colorado is Lone Eagle Peak in Granby.
